title: Library management
saveSearchHint: Saves the current keyword, tags, category and sort order.
listAddNew: New list name (leave blank to use the list above)
listDeleteConfirm: Delete the list "{name}"? Galleries inside it are kept.
seriesAddHint: Manually attach this gallery to the selected series; no other member is removed.
seriesAlready: This gallery is already in the series
seriesNone: No series yet; create one on the series page.
batchFavoriteHint: Local state follows the cloud result; failed items stay selected.
batchFavoriteNoGid: {count} items have no gid and were skipped
deleteSelectedBody: This removes the {count} selected galleries and cannot be undone.
deleteFilesHint: Leave unchecked to remove records only; files stay on disk.
filteredDeleteTitle: Delete every match of the current filter
filteredDeleteBody: Deletes every gallery matching the current filters, not only the loaded items.
filteredDeleteEmpty: No filters are active, so filtered delete is disabled
filteredDeleteLargeBody: {count} galleries match, above the safety threshold. Type the match count to confirm.
gidMissing: Selected items have no gid and cannot be favourited
selectionHint: Tick the checkbox on a card to run batch actions
redownloadCopyBody: This gallery is not in the download folder. Redownloading creates a second copy there, keeps the original folder, and lists it on the duplicates page.
restoreConfirmBody: The gallery is unpacked into the download folder and the cold pack is deleted afterwards. This cannot be undone.
